ValidationRule.description: Paid timestamp is required only for Paid invoices, must be after the issue date, not in the future, and not in the last 5 minutes of a day.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Paid'), ISBLANK(Paid_At__c)), AND(NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Paid')), NOT(ISBLANK(Paid_At__c))), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Paid_At__c)), OR( DATEVALUE(Paid_At__c) < Issue_Date__c, Paid_At__c > NOW(), AND(HOUR(TIMEVALUE(Paid_At__c)) = 23, MINUTE(TIMEVALUE(Paid_At__c)) >= 55) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Paid At is missing, premature, in the future or in the final minutes of the day.
